mapper.select: SELECT p.prod_id AS prodId, p.prod_name AS prodName, p.brand, p.client_id AS clientId, p.prod_price AS prodPrice, i.inventory_id AS inventoryId, i.ware_id AS wareId, i.quantity, i.last_inbound_date AS lastInboundDate, i.last_outbound_date AS lastOutboundDate, wa.ware_name AS wareName, wa.ware_address AS wareAddress FROM inventory i JOIN product p ON i.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN category c ON p.prod_categoryid = c.prod_categoryid JOIN warehouse_area wa ON i.ware_id = wa.ware_id WHERE i.client_id = #{clientId}
